component.name: Semaphore MCP Server
component.summary: Model Context Protocol server for Semaphore UI integration

description.p: A comprehensive MCP server providing complete access to Semaphore UI API functionality through the Model Context Protocol, enabling AI assistants and other tools to interact with Semaphore automation platform.

ul.li: Project, template, task, and inventory management
Task launching, stopping, and output retrieval
Support for both STDIO and HTTP transports

description.p: Live capability audit fixes: VariableGroupApi for environments, raw GET for schedule list and key get, MCP tool annotations, live scenario test.
Initial release with 35 tools covering full Semaphore UI API.
